about: Real Agent 1 IR rows for the band repairs (_repair_split_bands, _repair_band_tiers), copied verbatim from the read-only IR cache data/cache/agent1_ir/. Each case names its file, its SHA-256 and the slice of target.inclusion_rules it is. carolina_no_line: two torn HbA1c bands whose rows carry no source_text (the IR predates the field). carolina_three_tiers: CAROLINA's three HbA1c bands, each torn into a PRESENCE lower and an ABSENCE upper half, written on three different protocol lines. empareg_bmi_then_hba1c: the one adjacent pair in the IR cache on two different quantities sharing domain, unit, reference bound and window. carolina_egfr_windows: one eGFR band whose two halves carry different windows.
